name: HR Chronicle
description_en:
HR Chronicle is a cloud HR and payroll system oriented toward UAE and GCC employers. Employee records, document expiry alerts, leave, attendance and self-service connect to payroll functions such as WPS SIF output and end-of-service calculations.

Its commercial model is a headcount- and module-specific subscription with implementation support described as included. Country and employer-specific rules still need acceptance testing: vendor claims of compliance do not independently verify a particular payroll or replace professional review.
description_zh:
HR Chronicle 是面向阿联酋及海湾地区雇主的云端 HR 与工资系统。员工档案、文档到期提醒、休假、考勤和自助连接到工资功能，例如 WPS SIF 文件及离职福利计算。

其订阅按人数和模块定制，官方说明包含实施支持。各国及具体雇主规则仍需验收，供应商合规声明不能独立验证某次工资，也不能代替专业审查。

core_features.explanation_en: Profiles hold contract, nationality and visa information, with stored documents and expiry email alerts.
core_features.explanation_zh: 档案保存合同、国籍及签证资料，文档支持到期邮件提醒。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure leave rules and approvals, use biometric/RFID or mobile location attendance, and expose employee requests and payslips.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可配置休假规则审批，使用生物识别、RFID 或移动位置考勤，并提供员工申请及工资单。

core_features.explanation_en: The vendor documents WPS SIF files, bank files, EOSB and DIFC DEWS calculations, plus retrospective adjustments.
core_features.explanation_zh: 供应商说明提供 WPS SIF、银行文件、EOSB、DIFC DEWS 计算及追溯调整。

pricing.summary_en: Headcount/module quote. Vendor states configuration, migration, parallel payroll and training included, with unlimited payroll runs; expedited implementation must be scoped.
pricing.summary_zh: 按人数和模块报价。官方称包含配置、迁移、并行工资及培训，工资运行不限次数；加急实施需明确范围。

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Treat document dates as operational data
sections.title_zh: 把文档日期作为运营数据
sections.en: HR Chronicle describes profiles with contracts, nationality, visa status, salary history and assigned assets. Documents can include visas, passports, Emirates ID and permits, with email expiry alerts. Multiple companies can be managed from one login and access is role-controlled. A useful onboarding example is to enter an employee’s legal entity, document expiry and opening leave balance, then check the intended HR user’s view and the reminder. The source supports tracking and notifications, not a guarantee that a permit remains valid or that every renewal action is performed automatically.
sections.zh: HR Chronicle 描述档案含合同、国籍、签证状态、薪资历史及分配资产。文档可包括签证、护照、Emirates ID 和许可证，并提供到期邮件提醒。一个登录可管理多家公司，访问按角色控制。入职示例可以录入所属实体、文档到期日及初始休假余额，再检查指定 HR 用户视图和提醒。来源支持跟踪和通知，不保证许可证持续有效，也不证明续期动作全部自动完成。

sections.title_en: Reconcile time, leave and the payroll file
sections.title_zh: 核对工时、休假与工资文件
sections.en: The feature page describes leave policies per employee group, approval workflows, shift rosters, biometric/RFID connections and mobile geofencing. Payroll can use paid, unpaid and partially paid leave, import monthly variables from Excel, generate SIF and bank files, and apply retrospective adjustments. For a pilot, use one unpaid-leave day and one overtime adjustment, then compare the source attendance, calculated pay, payslip and bank file. UAE payroll, DIFC DEWS and other GCC requirements are distinct cases; do not assume one configuration covers every entity. Advertised universal device compatibility and compliance were not independently tested.
sections.zh: 功能页描述按员工组设置休假政策、审批流程、轮班、生物识别或 RFID 连接以及移动围栏。工资可处理带薪、无薪及部分带薪休假，从 Excel 导入月度变量，生成 SIF 和银行文件，并作追溯调整。试运行可包含一天无薪假及一次加班调整，再比较原始考勤、计算工资、工资单和银行文件。阿联酋工资、DIFC DEWS 及其他海湾地区规则属于不同场景，不能假定一个配置覆盖所有实体。所有设备兼容和合规宣传均未独立测试。

sections.title_en: Price headcount, modules and the implementation
sections.title_zh: 按人数、模块和实施确认报价
sections.en: The pricing page publishes no numeric rate. It says headcount, selected modules and support requirements determine the subscription, and describes Core HR & Payroll with optional leave, ESS, attendance, performance, loans, expenses and assets. Configuration, migration, parallel payroll and training are stated as included, while expedited implementation packages are available for larger or faster projects. The vendor says unlimited payroll runs carry no per-payslip or per-SIF fee. Its FAQ says there is no strict minimum, while describing customers from 30 employees upward; obtain explicit eligibility and pricing for a smaller employer. The free demo is not a sustained free operational plan.
sections.zh: 价格页未公布金额，表示订阅由人数、所选模块及支持需求决定，并列出基础 HR 与工资及可选休假、自助、考勤、绩效、借款、费用和资产。官方称包含配置、迁移、并行工资及培训，大型或更快项目另有加急实施方案，工资运行不限次数且无逐张工资单或 SIF 文件费。FAQ 称无严格最低人数，同时描述从 30 人起的客户，小型雇主需明确确认资格和报价。免费演示不是可长期运营的免费套餐。

sections.title_en: Use the parallel period as an acceptance point
sections.title_zh: 把并行期间作为验收点
sections.en: The published indicative rollout spans requirements and configuration, data migration, parallel payroll, then training and go-live, totaling about four to six weeks in the vendor’s comparison. That is a vendor schedule rather than a delivery promise. Prepare employee identifiers, entities, pay components, cost centers, leave balances and history, then agree the criteria for matching two parallel payroll cycles. Support is described during UAE business hours, so confirm deadlines and escalation for payroll exceptions. Hosting jurisdiction, independent certification scope, backups, correction history, export completeness, specific connectors and source-code licensing remain unverified. This was public documentation research without a live payroll run.
sections.zh: 官方示意流程包括需求配置、迁移、并行工资、培训及上线，在其对比中约为四至六周。这是供应商时间表，不是交付保证。需准备员工编号、实体、工资组成、成本中心、休假余额和历史，再约定两轮并行工资的匹配标准。官方支持按阿联酋工作时间提供，因此需确认工资异常的截止和升级路径。托管辖区、独立认证范围、备份、更正历史、完整导出、具体连接器及源代码许可均未核实；本研究没有执行真实工资。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: No device, tenant, payroll calculation, SIF bank submission or general-ledger connection was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试设备、租户、工资计算、SIF 银行提交或总账连接。

research_gaps.en: Exact quote, local rule configuration, hosting, certification scope and exports remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 具体报价、本地规则配置、托管、认证范围及导出仍未核实。
